blocks.text: CALASIAO, Pangasinan – A 34-year-old cook from San Fernando City, La Union, died after the motorcycle he was driving collided with a pickup truck along the national highway in Barangay Pagdaraoan early Friday. Initial investigation showed that the victim was traveling northbound while a pickup truck, driven by a 51-year-old fish vendor from Bacnotan town, was driving south. While reaching a highway curve, the motorcycle driver reportedly overshot that portion of the road and encroached into the pickup truck’s lane, police said.
